note.default: Builds Link's Awakening DX from your ROM for 13 consoles at once, all in Docker (it must be installed and running). Known to play: PS4 (hardware), PS3 (RPCS3), 3DS (emulator and hardware). Known to run: Wii, Android, the browser; Dreamcast boots but is slow. Builds but untested: GameCube, PS2, PSP, Vita, Xbox 360; the original Xbox hangs at boot. The first run downloads about 20 GB of toolchains and takes 1 to 2 hours; the builds land in builds/.
note.darwin: Builds Link's Awakening DX from your ROM for 13 consoles at once, all in Docker Desktop (it must be installed and running). Known to play: PS4 (hardware), PS3 (RPCS3), 3DS (emulator and hardware). Known to run: Wii, Android, the browser; Dreamcast boots but is slow. Builds but untested: GameCube, PS2, PSP, Vita, Xbox 360; the original Xbox hangs at boot. The toolchains are x86 images: on Apple silicon they run emulated and take several hours. The builds land in builds/.
